description: This file defines the interface 'DeviceManagementService' in Java, outlining methods for managing device registration operations such as create, read, update, and delete within the Hono platform. It includes detailed Javadoc comments describing each method's purpose, parameters, and expected behavior.

classes.name: DeviceManagementService
classes.description: A service interface for managing devices in the Eclipse Hono platform. It provides methods for creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting device registration data, designed to be implemented by backend services handling device management operations.

methods.name: createDevice
methods.description: Registers a new device under a specific tenant. It accepts device details and reports success or conflict status via a handler.

methods.name: readDevice
methods.description: Retrieves device registration data for a specified device ID within a tenant.

methods.name: updateDevice
methods.description: Updates registration data for a specific device, given a resource version for concurrency control.

methods.name: deleteDevice
methods.description: Removes a device registration, identified by device ID and resource version.
